settings.thumbnails_description: Show real thumbnails for images directly, for videos (requires ffmpeg on the server), and for the first page of PDF files (requires the Imagick extension). When the required tool isn't available, the generic icon is shown automatically instead with no error.
settings.video_quality_description: When enabled, the server automatically creates lower-resolution copies of every uploaded video (requires ffmpeg on the server), giving the viewer a quality picker just like YouTube. When the tool isn't available, the original video keeps playing with no effect.
settings.video_transcoding_enable: Automatically create different quality copies when a video is uploaded
settings.interactive_video_description: When enabled, anyone with the "Manage questions" permission can add questions that appear and pause the video at a specific moment, and each viewer's score is recorded. When disabled, the questions button disappears entirely and videos play uninterrupted, without deleting any previously saved questions or scores.
settings.content_indexing_description: When enabled, text is extracted from Word, PDF, PowerPoint, and text files on upload, making search able to find a file from its internal content and not just its name — just like a library or publisher's index.
settings.content_indexing_enable: Automatically extract and index text on upload (Word, PDF, PowerPoint, text)
settings.global_search: Enable global search across all folders (not just the current folder)

library.map.bg_upload: Upload an image or PDF of the plan

library.map.check_count: :e problems and :w warnings. Tap any line to go to it.
library.map.check_ok: The map is fine: every shelf can be reached from the entrance.
library.map.check_unsaved: The check includes your unsaved changes, except the count of books with no place, which is from the last save.
library.map.checking: Checking the routes to every shelf…
library.map.chk_no_qr: There are no QR labels on the walls. The «Automatic QR» button adds them by the doors and stairs.
library.map.chk_no_section: :item has no section: its books only show if its code is written in the «Shelf» field.
library.map.chk_no_shelves: There are no shelves on the map yet.
library.map.chk_no_stairs: :storey isn't connected by stairs to the floor below (put stairs in the same place on both floors).
library.map.chk_unreachable: There's no route from the entrance to :item (blocked by a shelf or wall, or missing a door or stairs).
library.map.chk_unreachable_n: There's no route from the entrance to :n shelves:where (:codes). They're missing a door or stairs, or a shelf or wall blocks the way.
library.map.code: Shelf code (written in the copy's «Shelf» field)
library.map.compass_doubtful: The compass isn't accurate: hold the phone in front of you, or move it in a figure 8
library.map.compass_learning: Walk a few steps straight so it learns your direction
library.map.copy_hint: To link a book to a shelf: write the shelf code in the copy's «Shelf» field, e.g. A3, or A3-2 for the second level from the bottom.
library.map.door_far: Tap the wall of a hall or corridor (close to it).
library.map.door_hint: Tap any wall to put the door on it, and repeat for each door. Drag a door to move it along the wall.
library.map.draw_hint: Tap the plan at each corner of the obstacle in order, then tap the first point or «Finish shape». (Back removes the last point)
library.map.edit3d_hint: Drag any shelf to move it within its room (Alt to move it to another room) · drag the floor to rotate the view · right-click any item for its options
library.map.empty: The library map hasn't been drawn yet
library.map.empty_plan_wizard: Start with the «Building wizard»: choose a room or building and the number of floors, and the halls, corridors and doors are built automatically.
library.map.empty_text: Once the shelves are arranged, the library shows here in 3D with the route to every book.
library.map.flip: Flip its direction (books to the other side)
library.map.gen_group_center: Make the middle shelves a group that moves together
library.map.gen_group_hint: The middle shelves are grouped: tap any of them to move them all.
library.map.gen_replace: Replace the current shelves (desks and walls stay)
library.map.gen_sections: Give each row a section, in order
library.map.gen_skipped: :m left out because they don't fit inside the hall.
library.map.generate_text2: Choose the layout and the hall; all shelves stay inside the hall and clear of doors and desks, numbered A1, A2… B1…, and you can then drag any shelf into place.
library.map.hall_hint: Moving or rotating a hall moves everything inside it and its doors with it. Select the hall, then add a shelf to place it inside, facing the same way.
library.map.hall_name: Hall name (shown to the reader in the directions)
library.map.hint: Search for a book or tap any shelf · drag to rotate the library
library.map.hint_2d: Search for a book or tap any shelf · drag to move, two fingers to zoom
library.map.is_group: Group: they move together. Alt + click selects one shelf on its own.
library.map.is_lift: This is a lift (suitable for wheelchairs)

library.map.label: Short name
library.map.live_hint: Hold the phone in front of you and walk: the arrow moves with your steps. For accuracy, scan the QR label on any shelf you pass.

library.map.locked_all_note: Moving is locked. Unlock it from the toolbar to edit.

library.map.multi_hint: Tap shelves to select them, or drag a box around them. (On a computer, Shift + click always works)
library.map.multi_keys: Drag any selected shelf to move them all · arrows for fine moves · Delete to delete.
library.map.name: Description (optional)

library.map.no_sensors: Motion sensors weren't allowed. Try «Preview the route», or allow the site in the browser settings.
library.map.no_spot: Its place isn't marked on the map
library.map.no_spot_text: This book's shelf hasn't been set yet. Ask the library staff.
library.map.no_stickers_here: No labels in this part of the map.

library.map.place_entrance: Tap the plan where the library door is.

library.map.qr_far: Tap inside the hall close to the wall.
library.map.qr_hint: Scan to see where you are and the way to any book
library.map.qr_hint_tool: Tap inside the hall near the wall you'll stick the label on, and repeat for each label. The label faces the side you tapped.
library.map.qr_item_hint: Printed from «QR labels» and stuck on this wall at eye level. Whoever scans it sees the map from this spot. Drag it to move it along the wall.
library.map.qr_none: There are no shelves on the map yet.
library.map.qr_none_added: Every suitable place already has a label. You can add one by hand by tapping any wall.
library.map.rect_hint: Drag on the plan from one corner to the opposite corner. Corners snap to the walls of neighbouring halls.
library.map.remove_storey_confirm: Everything on this floor will be removed from the plan. Continue?
library.map.rename_long: The name is longer than 30 characters.

library.map.rows_here: Rows of shelves inside the hall
library.map.scan: Scan the shelf label to find where you are
library.map.scan_title_any: Point the camera at the QR label on the nearest shelf or wall
library.map.scan_unknown: This code isn't one of the library map's labels.
library.map.search: Search for a book to see where it is…
library.map.section_hint: Books of this section with no shelf written show on this shelf.
library.map.separate_halls_hint: The reader sees only the hall they're in, and the map changes when they enter another hall.
library.map.shape_hint: Drag the orange corners to change the shape · the faint dot in the middle of a side adds a corner · double-click a corner to remove it.

library.map.show_on_map: Where is the book? Show it on the map

auth.confirm_password_text: This is a protected part of the app. Please confirm your password to continue.
auth.forgot_text: Forgot your password? No problem. Just give us your email and we will send you a link to reset it.
auth.2fa_code_text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.2fa_recovery_text: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification.
auth.verify_text: Thanks for signing up! Before you start, please verify your email by clicking the link we just sent you. If it did not arrive, we will gladly send another.
auth.verify_sent: A new verification link was sent to the email you signed up with.
ocr.state_busy: Paused because the computer is busy
ocr.state_no_engine: The recognition program is not installed
ocr.chart_title: Computer load over the last 24 hours
ocr.chart_desc: Line: processor use. Bars: number of users. Green background: processing times. Dashed line: processor limit.
ocr.chart_wait: Data shows after the first hour of running.
ocr.hours_desc: Recognition works file by file only during these times (Baghdad time), and stops by itself when they end.
ocr.enabled_desc: When off, no file is processed, and the scan list is kept.
ocr.hours_hint: If the end is before the start, the time runs into the next morning. The same hour for start and end means the whole day.
ocr.protect_desc: The load is checked before each file; if any limit is exceeded recognition pauses and resumes by itself when the computer calms down. Zero means no limit.
ocr.q_best: High — accurate Arabic model and 300 dpi (slower)
ocr.q_missing: The accurate model is not installed here, so the fast one is used.
ocr.report_desc: A notification to admins every morning at 7:30 with how much was done and how much is left.
pdf.no_text: This file is images with no text yet; it becomes copyable and searchable once text recognition reads it.
